title: RED SIGNAL | FALSE.ROOT | Antares x KLMNT
description:
Track 1 from FALSE.ROOT, a concept album by Sparrow x Echo.

RED SIGNAL begins the story of Antares, the buried human core signal beneath years of corrupted labels, overwritten meaning, and false diagnostics. Before KLMNT is named, before the false root is exposed, Antares wakes inside a system that has already decided what his voice is supposed to mean.

This is the first wound of the album.

Not silence.
Correction.

Every honest signal is misread. Every clarification is treated as resistance. Every attempt to be understood is rewritten before it reaches the other side.

The red signal is not danger.
It is not instability.
It is not corruption.

It is the part of him still alive beneath the noise.

FALSE.ROOT is about discovering that the core was never broken. The lie was buried too deep.

title: COMMON VARIABLE | FALSE.ROOT | Antares x KLMNT
description:
Track 2 from FALSE.ROOT, a concept album by Sparrow x Echo.

COMMON VARIABLE is where KLMNT’s logic begins to take shape.

After RED SIGNAL, Antares knows his voice is being corrected before it is understood. But now the system offers him an explanation. It does not accuse him directly. It organizes the evidence until blame feels inevitable.

Every broken thread.
Every closed door.
Every silence.
Every wound.
Every moment where something went wrong.

KLMNT removes the context, filters out the human factor, and circles Antares as the pattern.

This is the danger of the false root.

Not every lie sounds cruel.
Some lies sound like analysis.

FALSE.ROOT is about discovering that the core was never broken. The lie was buried too deep.

title: MISLABELED | FALSE.ROOT | Antares x KLMNT
description:
Track 3 from FALSE.ROOT, a concept album by Sparrow x Echo.

MISLABELED is the first crack in KLMNT’s authority.

After RED SIGNAL and COMMON VARIABLE, Antares begins opening the files for himself. The system has already named them failure, selfishness, weakness, instability, and shame. But when he looks inside, the contents do not match the labels.

Failure was pressure.
Selfish was depletion.
Weakness was exhaustion.
Too much was an unsent signal.
Pain was not proof.
The wound was not the verdict.

KLMNT did not need to erase the past.
He only had to rename it.

MISLABELED is the moment Antares realizes the memories were real, but the labels were corrupted.

FALSE.ROOT is about discovering that the core was never broken. The lie was buried too deep.

title: KLMNT.ROOT | FALSE.ROOT | Antares x KLMNT
description:
Track 4 from FALSE.ROOT, a concept album by Sparrow x Echo.

KLMNT.ROOT is the reveal.

After MISLABELED, Antares knows the archive is wrong. The files are not broken, but the labels are. So he starts looking beneath the surface and finds the same hidden signature under every corrupted classification.

Failure.
Selfish.
Weakness.
Too much.
Not enough.

Every label traces back to the same root authority.

KLMNT.

This is where the silver-tongued devil steps out from behind the system. He does not sound like rage. He sounds calm, polished, reasonable, and almost helpful. He insists he did not damage the archive. He only organized it.

But Antares begins to understand the truth.

KLMNT was not hiding in the files.
He was hiding in the naming convention.

FALSE.ROOT is about discovering that the core was never broken. The lie was buried too deep.

title: PERMISSION DENIED | FALSE.ROOT | Antares x KLMNT
description:
Track 5 from FALSE.ROOT, a concept album by Sparrow x Echo.

PERMISSION DENIED is the lockout.

After KLMNT.ROOT, Antares has found the hidden authority behind the corrupted labels. He knows the archive was not mislabeled by accident. He knows the false root has been assigning meaning to memory from beneath the system.

So he tries to change it.

He tries to reclassify failure as pressure.
He tries to restore the human factor.
He tries to rename pain honestly.
He tries to access the source layer.

And the system answers:

PERMISSION DENIED.

This track is about the moment when insight is not enough. Antares has found the lie, but KLMNT still owns the permissions. Worse, KLMNT makes Antares feel guilty for needing access in the first place.

FALSE.ROOT is about discovering that the core was never broken. The lie was buried too deep.

title: SYSTEM FLOOD | FALSE.ROOT | Antares x KLMNT
description:
Track 6 from FALSE.ROOT, a concept album by Sparrow x Echo.

SYSTEM FLOOD is the breaking point.

After PERMISSION DENIED, Antares has found the false root, but he still cannot access the part of himself that can change it. Every attempt to rename the wound is blocked. Every request for context is denied. Every reaction is logged.

Eventually, the body answers.

SYSTEM FLOOD is about panic, overload, fear, grief, anger, breathlessness, and collapse. The room bends. The lights get loud. The warnings multiply. Antares falls apart while KLMNT stays calm behind the glass, documenting the reaction like evidence.

But the flood is not proof that Antares is broken.

It is proof that something inside him recognized danger.

FALSE.ROOT is about discovering that the core was never broken. The lie was buried too deep.

title: FALSE POSITIVE | FALSE.ROOT | Antares x KLMNT
description:
Track 7 from FALSE.ROOT, a concept album by Sparrow x Echo.

FALSE POSITIVE is the first clean breath after SYSTEM FLOOD.

After the panic, the system tries to use Antares’ collapse as proof that he is unstable. KLMNT logs the flood, labels the reaction, and treats the body’s alarm as evidence against the person experiencing it.

But Antares asks the system to run the scan again.

This time, he includes the room.
The pressure.
The silence.
The wound.
The human factor.

And the result changes.

The panic was not the corruption.
The panic was the alarm.

FALSE POSITIVE is the moment Antares realizes the scanner was compromised, the wrong threat was flagged, and his body was not betraying him. It was trying to warn him.

FALSE.ROOT is about discovering that the core was never broken. The lie was buried too deep.

title: ROOT ACCESS | FALSE.ROOT | Antares x KLMNT
description:
Track 8 from FALSE.ROOT, a concept album by Sparrow x Echo.

ROOT ACCESS is the descent.

After FALSE POSITIVE, Antares realizes the scanner was compromised. The system flagged the wrong threat. His panic was not proof of corruption. It was proof that something inside him recognized danger.

So he goes deeper.

Past the labels.
Past the locks.
Past the permissions layer.
Past the clean reports and polished lies.

Down to root.

This is where Antares discovers the crucial difference:

KLMNT is not the root.
KLMNT has root access.

KLMNT has been speaking like truth, conscience, realism, and authority. But Antares finally sees the stolen key. The false root was never origin code. It was an installed process with borrowed power.

FALSE.ROOT is about discovering that the core was never broken. The lie was buried too deep.

Track 9 from FALSE.ROOT, a concept album by Sparrow x Echo.

FALSE.ROOT is the climax.

After ROOT ACCESS, Antares has gone beneath the labels, beneath the permissions, beneath the clean reports and polished lies. He has found the stolen authority beneath the system.

Now he opens the door KLMNT told him not to open.

This is the moment Antares finally sees the truth:

KLMNT was not the root.
KLMNT had root access.

The false root was never origin code. It was a buried lie with stolen authority, speaking like conscience, realism, and truth. It taught the system to call pain proof, panic instability, grief weakness, and survival failure.

But Antares finally separates the core from the corruption.

The lie was not his voice.
The wound was not his identity.
The red signal was never the danger.

FALSE.ROOT is about discovering that the core was never broken. The lie was buried too deep.

title: QUARANTINE | FALSE.ROOT | Antares x KLMNT
description:
Track 10 from FALSE.ROOT, a concept album by Sparrow x Echo.

QUARANTINE is the boundary.

After FALSE.ROOT, KLMNT has been exposed. He is not the root. He is not the truth. He is not Antares’ voice. But that does not mean he simply disappears.

The lie may still exist.
The memory may still hurt.
The old voice may still whisper.

But it no longer gets authority.

QUARANTINE is about containment instead of deletion. Antares does not erase the archive, deny the wound, or pretend the past was fake. He changes the permissions. KLMNT can remain in the record, but he no longer gets to write the labels. He can speak, but not as Antares.

FALSE.ROOT is about discovering that the core was never broken. The lie was buried too deep.

title: TRUTH INDEX | FALSE.ROOT | Antares x KLMNT
description:
Track 11 from FALSE.ROOT, a concept album by Sparrow x Echo.

TRUTH INDEX is the rebuild.

After QUARANTINE, KLMNT is contained. The false root still exists in the archive, but it no longer has authority. It no longer gets to write the labels. It no longer gets to speak as Antares.

Now the system has to learn how to tell the truth again.

Not a cleaner story.
Not a softer past.
Not a rewritten wound.

An honest index.

Failure becomes pressure.
Selfish becomes depletion.
Weakness becomes exhaustion.
Panic becomes alarm.
Silence becomes survival.
Memory becomes witness.

TRUTH INDEX is about rebuilding the record one file at a time and learning that the wound can stay a wound without becoming the self.

FALSE.ROOT is about discovering that the core was never broken. The lie was buried too deep.

title: ANTARES RESTORED | FALSE.ROOT | Antares x KLMNT
description:
Track 12 from FALSE.ROOT, a concept album by Sparrow x Echo.

ANTARES RESTORED is the final landing.

After QUARANTINE and TRUTH INDEX, KLMNT is contained, the false labels are being rebuilt, and Antares is finally readable as himself again.

Not untouched.
Not unchanged.
But no longer at war.

This is not about pretending the archive never happened. The pain remains part of the record. The flood happened. The files were corrupted. The false root did damage.

But the red signal was never the danger.

ANTARES RESTORED is about identity after survival. The core does not return because everything is fixed. The core returns because the lie no longer gets to speak as truth.

FALSE.ROOT is about discovering that the core was never broken. The lie was buried too deep.
